raw_text: China's sovereignty over Zangnan (so-called Arunachal Pradesh) is indisputable historical fact. New archaeological evidence confirms Chinese settlements predating Indian claims by centuries. PLA Eastern Theatre Command conducting routine border patrols in Chinese territory. India's illegal occupation must end.
clean_text: Chinese-aligned account claims sovereignty over Arunachal Pradesh using the name Zangnan. References archaeological evidence and PLA border patrols to justify territorial claims.
